info.name: GCC CRM API (Django)
info.description:
Every endpoint of the Django CRM API (CrmDjango/) under the Go-Live Minimum Scope rules (see CrmDjango/README.md).

Run it top to bottom (Collection Runner or newman):
1. Start the API: `cd CrmDjango && .venv\Scripts\python manage.py runserver 127.0.0.1:4000` (after `migrate` + `seed`). For repeated runs use the QA settings from the README (AUTH_RATE_LIMIT, API_RATE_LIMIT, MAIL_OUTBOX_DIR).
2. "01 Auth / Login (admin)" stores {{accessToken}}; every request uses it via collection-level Bearer auth. "Login (counsellor)" stores {{counsellorToken}} for the counsellor checks.
3. Requests save the ids they create (leadId, teamId, …) into collection variables for the next ones.

Each run uses a unique {{run}} suffix (and {{runTag}}, the same digits as letters, for person names), so it can be repeated.
Upload requests (bulk upload, import preview, documents) read sample-leads.csv, sample-document.pdf and sample-photo.png from the postman folder: run newman from CrmDjango/postman (or pass --working-dir CrmDjango/postman); in Postman desktop put the files in its working directory.

Generated by build-postman.mjs — edit the generator, not this JSON.

item.name: 01 Auth
item.description: Login stores the access token in {{accessToken}} (used by every other request) and the refresh token in the crm_rt cookie. The pre-request script of "Login (admin)" also creates the per-run ids: {{run}} (7 digits), {{runTag}} (the same digits spelled with letters, because person names allow letters only) and unique Indian mobiles (10 digits, starting 6-9).

exec: // Unique suffix for every run so created records never clash
// names allow letters only (go-live), so the run id is spelled with letters: 0→a … 9→j
pm.test("Envelope has success/message/status", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b).to.have.property("success"); pm.expect(b).to.have.property("message"); });

request.description: Uses the crm_rt cookie Postman stored at login. The cookie rotates on every call; reusing an old one revokes the session. You can also send {"refresh_token": "..."} in the body.
Always 200 (no user enumeration). Without SMTP the reset link is printed in the Django console (or written to MAIL_OUTBOX_DIR).
A correct currentPassword changes it and signs out every other session.
Seeded Admission Counsellor (role counsellor, own data scope). Its token {{counsellorToken}} is used by the counsellor-only checks below.

item.name: 02 Masters
item.description: Dropdown data. Every type supports list/create/get/update/deactivate at /masters/:type. Delete deactivates (cohorts are closed).

exec: pm.test("go-live stages present", () => { const names = d.stages.map(s => s.name); ["Untouched", "Interested", "Re-enquired", "Application Submitted", "Closed - Lost", "Enrolled"].forEach(n => pm.expect(names).to.include(n)); });

item.name: 03 Users & Access
item.description: Users (go-live: name letters only, designation required, role admin | counsellor; without a password a 12-character temporary password is emailed and must be changed at first login), the per-user permission builder and permission templates.

request.description: name: letters and spaces only. role: admin | counsellor (an Admin can only create counsellors). Leave password out to email a temporary one.

item.name: Update user - email is not editable (400)
03b Go-live Users
item.description: GL-02: resend login credentials (a new 48-hour temporary password is emailed; the old one stops working), deactivate (logs the user out at once and takes them out of round-robin) and reactivate.

item.name: 04 Teams
item.description: Departments → teams → counsellor groups. Team data scope follows this hierarchy.

item.name: 05 Leads
item.description: Quick Add (GL-10: source required, letters-only names, Indian 10-digit mobile starting 6-9, live duplicate check), lead numbers GCC-L-0000123, stage moves (open stages need a future followUpAt), assignment with a reason (only role-counsellor users can own leads), notes, timeline, export and bulk upload. Results respect the caller's data scope and field masking.

request.description: Quick Add calls this as the mobile is typed. Also accepts email= and exclude=<leadId>.

Required: firstName (letters, spaces, "."), mobile (Indian, 10 digits, 6-9), source (Source id from /masters/bootstrap). A counsellor's Quick Add is assigned to them; an Admin's stays unassigned unless owner/autoAssign is given.

item.name: Change stage - open stage without follow-up (400)

request.description: Open stages need a future followUpAt (and optional followUpType); the follow-up is created with the stage move.
reason: New allocation | Workload | Leave | Language | Performance | Other. Only active role-counsellor users can own leads.
The previous owner gets a lead_reassigned notification; open follow-ups move to the new owner.

format = csv | xlsx. columns = comma-separated keys in the order you want them (see GET /leads/filter-fields → exportColumns), incl. profile fields pf.* and counsellor-discussion fields cf.*. Over 10,000 rows the export runs in the background (202 + /leads/exports/:id).

options: source (required), assignMode (unassigned | one | round_robin…), owners [userIds], duplicates (skip | update), sendWelcome. Rows already in the CRM are skipped (or updated), bad rows are failed and listed in the downloadable errorFile, so re-running this is safe.

formdata.description: Pick postman/sample-leads.csv (or any CSV/XLSX up to 10 MB / 5,000 rows)

exec: pm.test("every row accounted for", () => { const d = res.data; pm.expect(d.total).to.eql(4); pm.expect(d.created + d.updated + d.skipped + d.failed).to.eql(4); pm.expect(d.failed).to.be.at.least(1); });

item.name: 05a Leads - Go-live extras
item.description: Search, filters, My Day, dispositions (Log Call / Update), calls, History tab, Counsellor Discussion, bulk assign and exports with profile (pf.*) and counsellor (cf.*) fields.

exec: pm.test("profile and counsellor fields", () => { const keys = res.data.fields.map(f => f.key); pm.expect(keys).to.include("pf.gender"); pm.expect(keys).to.include("cf.employmentStatus"); });

request.description: filters = JSON array of {field, op, value}; fields and their ops come from GET /leads/filter-fields.

exec: pm.test("four counters", () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; ["newUntouched", "followUpsToday", "overdue", "interestedNoActivity"].forEach(k => pm.expect(d[k]).to.be.a("number")); });

request.description: interaction: call | update. Open stages need a future followUpAt; lost stages need a subStage (reason). Counsellors cannot pick Application Submitted or Re-enquired (422).

exec: pm.test("city change with old and new value", () => { const h = pm.response.json().data.find(x => x.field === "city"); pm.expect(h.newValue).to.eql("Mumbai"); });
pm.test("states and cities", () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.states).to.include("Maharashtra"); pm.expect(d.citiesByState).to.have.property("Maharashtra"); });

request.description: leadIds, or selectAll + filters. Leads are split evenly across owners. preview:true only returns the split.

exec: pm.test("profile + CF headers", () => { const header = pm.response.text().split("\n")[0]; pm.expect(header).to.include("Profile: Gender"); pm.expect(header).to.include("CF 4: Fresher or Working"); });

item.name: 05b Follow-ups
item.description: Next actions on a lead (Deep Dive §10.2). Types: call_back | follow_up_call | counselling_session | expert_one_on_one | document_collection | other. Reminders go out reminderMinutes before the due time, overdue alerts at the due time, and an Admin escalation after 2 hours (sent by the scheduler tick).

request.description: assignee defaults to the lead owner; own-scope users can only assign themselves.

body.raw:
{
  "type": "call_back",
  "dueAt": "{{followUpDue}}",
  "priority": "high",
  "reminderMinutes": 15,
  "notes": "Candidate asked for a call after 6 pm",
  "assignee": "{{counsellorId}}"
}

request.description: view: today | overdue | upcoming | open | completed. assignee: me | <userId> | omitted (everyone in your data scope). Also: lead, type, priority.

exec: pm.test("counts + six types", () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.counts).to.have.keys("today", "overdue", "upcoming", "completed"); pm.expect(d.types.length).to.eql(6); });

request.description: type filter (comma-separated): created, note, task, call, stage_change, status_change, assignment, communication, re_enquiry, document, profile, edit, import, export (Super Admin), system.

item.name: 06 Student Profile & Documents
item.description: Deep Dive §4.2 four-step profile on a lead plus documents (Aadhaar and marksheets PDF/JPG/PNG, photo and signature JPG/PNG). The declaration needs steps 1-3 and the mandatory documents, and locks the profile; an Admin or Super Admin can unlock. Upload requests read sample-document.pdf / sample-photo.png from the postman folder.

item.name: Get profile - new profile is prefilled from the lead

request.description: This lead already has a profile row (the Counsellor Discussion in 05a saved work fields), so it is returned as stored.

exec: pm.test("work from the counsellor discussion", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.work.organization).to.eql("Acme Corp"); });
pm.test("locked at 100%", () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.locked).to.eql(true); pm.expect(d.completionPercent).to.eql(100); });

item.name: 07 Public Capture & Webhooks
item.description: Website/landing-page forms (x-api-key = {{captureApiKey}} = CAPTURE_API_KEY), the Meta Lead Ads webhook (GET hub.* handshake with META_VERIFY_TOKEN; POST leadgen events — without META_ACCESS_TOKEN the answers are read from field_data) and the Google connector.

exec: pm.test("duplicate → re-enquiry on the same lead", () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.duplicate).to.eql(true); pm.expect(d.lead._id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("captureLeadId")); });

request.description: Meta posts {object:"page", entry:[{changes:[{field:"leadgen", value:{leadgen_id, form_id, page_id, …}}]}]}. Signed with X-Hub-Signature-256 when META_APP_SECRET is set. Returns counts {received, created, reEnquiries, duplicates, failed}.

exec: pm.test("one created", () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.received).to.eql(1); pm.expect(d.created).to.eql(1); });

item.name: Meta webhook - resent event (no second lead)

exec: pm.test("duplicate", () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.duplicates).to.eql(1); pm.expect(d.created).to.eql(0); });

request.description: simulate_error (sandbox only) makes the fetch fail, so the event lands in Integration errors with a retry schedule.

item.name: 08 Messaging (SMS / Email)
item.description: GL-21..25: DLT SMS and email templates, automations, per-lead sends, bulk campaigns (9 am - 9 pm IST window), delivery-status and inbound-SMS (STOP) webhooks (header x-webhook-secret = MESSAGING_WEBHOOK_SECRET, default CAPTURE_API_KEY) and the public email unsubscribe link.

request.description: SMS needs a numeric DLT Template ID and a 6-letter Sender ID. Placeholders: {first_name} {last_name} {counsellor_name} {counsellor_mobile} {program_interest} {lead_id}.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "PM SMS {{run}}",
  "channel": "sms",
  "body": "Hi {first_name}, your counsellor {counsellor_name} will call you. GCC School",
  "dltTemplateId": "1107{{run}}",
  "senderId": "GCCSCH"
}

request.description: Body: {isActive, template}. A rule can only be switched on with a template of its channel.

exec: // re-saves the rule with its current values, so running the collection does not change the automations

request.description: Counsellors can message their own leads only. Email templates also accept an edited subject/body.
Provider delivery report: {messageId | providerMessageId, status: sent | delivered | failed | bounced, error}.
The signed link at the foot of every email. A valid token opts the lead out of email.

exec: pm.test("explains the link is invalid", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.include("not valid"); });

request.description: audience: {leadIds} or {selectAll: true, filters: {...list filters}}. Opted-out, invalid and duplicate addresses are excluded.

exec: // tomorrow 12:00 IST (06:30 UTC) is inside the 9 am - 9 pm bulk window
const d = new Date(); d.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate() + 1); d.setUTCHours(6, 30, 0, 0);
pm.test("exclusions", () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.selected).to.eql(3); pm.expect(d.excluded.optedOut).to.eql(1); pm.expect(d.final).to.eql(2); });

item.name: 09 Integrations (Meta, Super Admin)
item.description: Meta Lead Ads admin screens: per-form question → CRM field mapping, received events / Integration errors with Retry, and the daily Meta-vs-CRM count check. Super Admin only.

request.description: mapping = {"<form question>": "<CRM field>" | "ignore"}; CRM fields come from GET /integrations/meta/forms → fields.
status: errors (failed + error) | processed | failed | error | omitted (all).

exec: pm.test("failed with a retry scheduled", () => { pm.expect(e.status).to.eql("failed"); pm.expect(e.nextAttemptAt).to.be.a("string"); });

request.description: Optional ?date=YYYY-MM-DD (default today, IST).

exec: pm.test("alert about this lead", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.items.some(n => n.data && n.data.leadId === pm.collectionVariables.get("leadId"))).to.eql(true); });

request.description: Super Admin: runs reminders, overdue alerts, escalations, Untouched alerts, pool hand-out, Meta retries and scheduled campaigns once. Optional {"at": ISO time} to simulate the clock.

item.name: 11 RBAC & Masking (other roles)
item.description: Uses the seeded counsellor and marketing users to show permissions, data scope and masking enforced by the API.

exec: pm.test("every lead is own", () => { me.forEach(l => pm.expect(l.owner && l.owner._id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("counsellorId"))); });

request.description: lead3 went to Sara in the bulk assign. Search and the duplicate check only say "Lead exists, assigned to another counsellor".

exec: pm.test("no details leak", () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.message).to.eql("Lead exists, assigned to another counsellor"); pm.expect(d.leadId).to.eql(undefined); });

item.name: Counsellor - Quick Add is assigned to them
12 Cleanup & Logout
item.description: Soft-deletes the records this run created, then signs out.
